footprints.title: A first high-quality vector data of buildings in East Asian countries based on a comprehensive large-scale mapping framework
footprints.attribution: Qian Shi, Jiajun Zhu, Zhengyu Liu, Haonan Guo, Mengxi Liu, Zihong Liu and Xiaoping Liu (2023), East Asian building footprints

imagery.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025), processed by ESA / Microsoft Planetary Computer; local rendering derivatives

architecture.heightInference: OSM height/floors first; otherwise stable neighbourhood/type/area estimates. Near-airport village/logistics prior applies only to missing heights. Not surveyed heights.

modelNotes: Source footprint/contact geometry is retained. Repeated houses use shared estimated architectural templates, other ordinary buildings use shared mid-distance boxes and source-derived district proxies in the far distance. Heights/colours are source fields or deterministic estimates, not guaranteed surveys.
license: ODbL-1.0 combined database; CC-BY-4.0 East Asian footprint attribution retained
attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL; Shi et al. (2023), East Asian building footprints / CC-BY-4.0
selection: all available East Asian source footprints and updated OSM buildings across the full 60km terrain; source water, airport and road exclusions; no cell sampling
colourMethod: Sentinel-2 neighbourhood median (10 m source); vegetation/shadow rejection; estimated neutral regional facades
